I checked the Google reviews and thought it would be decent, but the food was just below average . Definitely not worth.

Also, be 100% sure about your order because once you say it, that's it. You can’t change your order even if it’s just a second later. No flexibility, no courtesy. The service felt rigid and unfriendly.
There is no good washroom. No proper handwash area
Overall, very disappointing experience. Won’t be coming back.
